tool_input.description: Debug getMatchingMethod ambiguity scenario in isolation

result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/reflect/MethodUtilsAgentTest.java` with 44 self-contained JUnit 5 test methods covering `MethodUtils`: method lookup (`getAccessibleMethod`, `getMatchingMethod`, `getMatchingAccessibleMethod`, `getMethodObject`), annotation discovery, override hierarchy, and the various `invoke(Exact)(Static)Method` overloads — including boundary/error cases like null-argument NPEs, `NoSuchMethodException`, ambiguous-overload `IllegalStateException`, empty method name, forced vs. non-forced private-method access, varargs canonicalization, and exception wrapping in `InvocationTargetException`. All 44 tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
